svg.text: PARENTCONNECT — Parent ERD: Reports, Conversations, and Guidance
Parent-submitted concerns, adviser conversation threads, and the guidance escalation workflow
PK primary key UQ unique field ● required ○ nullable
Orange connectors are intentional application-level identities in parent_adviser_reports; ticket and message links are declared FKs.
Every connector uses a private route and endpoint; no shared segments or T-junctions are used.
